About Geeta Enterprises

A local steel partner
for real requirements.

Geeta Enterprises is an iron and steel supplier based in Palda, Indore. Our business branding carries the year 1989, reflecting a long-standing presence in the local steel trade.

From sheet and plate enquiries to structural sections, we help customers communicate the specifications that matter: grade, gauge, size, length and quantity. Contact us directly to confirm current stock, rates and dispatch arrangements.
